title: Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks
authors: I. Sutskever, O. Vinyals, Q. Le
before: Translation was a pipeline of alignment models, phrase tables and reranking.
problem: No single trainable model took a sentence in and produced a sentence out.
breakthrough: Two stacked LSTMs, one reading and one writing, trained end to end on pairs.
why: Generation became a learned mapping rather than an assembled pipeline. This is the direct ancestor of prompt-in, text-out.
next: Attention was added within the year, and the Transformer replaced the recurrence three years later.
inherits: End-to-end sequence generation as the basic shape of the task.
